verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing says you can 'apply online in 10 minutes' and get business credit cards 'as soon as day one', which points to fast onboarding rather than a months-long process. But there is no documented approval timeline, account-opening SLA, or first-hand report of how long full onboarding actually takes. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end onboarding or approval timeframe, independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed, detail on verification/KYC steps.
